description: Defines the HpackWholeEntryBuffer class, which manages buffering and decoding of HPACK header entries in HTTP/2, handling entries that may be split across multiple buffers.

classes.name: HpackWholeEntryBuffer
classes.description: Manages buffering and decoding of a complete HPACK header entry, supporting entries split across multiple buffers, with callback mechanisms for header decoding events.

methods.name: HpackWholeEntryBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer with a listener and maximum string size.

methods.name: set_listener
methods.description: Sets the listener to be notified when a header entry is fully decoded.

methods.name: set_max_string_size_bytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of strings accepted, to prevent OOM attacks.

methods.name: BufferStringsIfUnbuffered
methods.description: Ensures decoded strings are buffered to allow transport buffer reuse.

methods.name: error_detected
methods.description: Returns whether an error has been detected during decoding.

methods.name: OnStartLiteralHeader
methods.description: Handles the start of a literal header.

methods.name: OnNameStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a header name.

methods.name: OnNameEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a header name.

methods.name: OnValueStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a header value.

methods.name: OnValueEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a header value.
